script:
$auth = Get-Content "$env:USERPROFILE\.local\share\opencode\auth.json" | ConvertFrom-Json
$token = $auth.opencode.key
"Token length: $($token.Length)"
$envPath = "C:\Users\E\AppData\Local\hermes\.env"
"OPENAI_API_KEY=$token" | Out-File -FilePath $envPath -Encoding utf8
"Written to .env"
Get-Content $envPath | ForEach-Object { if ($_ -match "^OPENAI_API_KEY=") { "OPENAI_API_KEY=" + $_.Substring(15, 10) + "..." } }
